correctness.rationale: The positive multishift weights commute by equality of elementary-square path products. Their levelwise maxima tend to zero, giving compact coordinates. Direct diagonal computation gives summed self-commutator dP_0; product bounds give coordinate quasinilpotence and hence joint quasinilpotence; a negative diagonal entry on each coordinate ray rules out coordinate hyponormality.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source explicitly leaves the compact sum-hyponormal question and the nilpotent-to-quasinilpotent extension open, and targeted exact/synonymous searches did not locate this counterexample. A 2020 characterization of spherically p-hyponormal two-variable weighted shifts remains a material residual risk because its full theorem statements and examples were not accessible.

value.rationale: The construction directly gives a negative answer to the compact sum-hyponormal normality question in every d>=2 and sharply separates nilpotent from quasinilpotent tuples. It additionally realizes the completely nonnormal quasinilpotent summand with an explicit rank-one positive defect.
